source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Check version of BMC/BIOS from BIOS
2. Send command to check version of BMC : ipmitool raw 0x30 0x20

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Command should be sent successfully
2. Versions should be shown correctly before and after flashing.

original_test_intent: Confirm the HIB-CPLD firmware version before and after a separate flash.
original_method: The item names HIB-CPLD, while copied Procedure checks BMC/BIOS using raw IPMI; DeepSeek proposes broad Redfish name matching.
manual_activity: Owner supplies the exact HIB-CPLD mapping and expected values; automated discovery, query, comparison and logging can perform the core test.
safety_requirements: Read only; no update, reset or undocumented raw write.
Do not accept broad HIB|CPLD regex matches without exact identity.
Preserve full responses and do not retry automatically.
agent_execution_scope: Discover the inventory, select the owner-mapped HIB-CPLD member, collect version/status and compare before/after evidence.
engineer_actions: Approve HIB-CPLD mapping and expected values.
Resolve source wording and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The assumed path and regex can select multiple or wrong components; it must not be executed as authoritative evidence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use trusted service discovery and an exact resource identifier, preserving full member JSON.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Copied raw IPMI method, script and 5/0-minute values remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Collect the exact HIB-CPLD inventory member and canonical version/status through a trusted read-only channel and compare to the approved matrix.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact component/property binding; source remains preserved.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Prevents another CPLD from satisfying the case.

project_override_considerations: An alternate IPMI/vendor query is acceptable only if its output is bound to the same HIB-CPLD and retained in full.
expected_evidence: Inventory discovery and exact HIB-CPLD member

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items require HIB-CPLD, but Procedure and Criteria describe BMC/BIOS without a HIB-CPLD selector or version field.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The intended version target is clear; a supplied resource mapping makes it safely automatable, so the conflict does not justify BLOCKED.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Rejects broad regex and assumed schema as proof.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Keeps evidence requirements but corrects classification to FULLY AUTOMATABLE under V3.1.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Records source conflict separately from readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Requires exact HIB-CPLD identity and version, not any HIB/CPLD-labelled entry.
independent_technical_reasoning: All core acceptance evidence can be collected by software once the authoritative member is supplied. The copied BMC/BIOS wording is a source defect, not a manual-operation requirement.
